name: Atari Jaguar
significance: Marked Atari's final standalone home hardware release, highlighting the industrial shift toward unified Japanese and 32-bit CD-ROM architectures.

editorialContent.overview: Marketed as the world's first 64-bit system, remembered for Jeff Minter's Tempest 2000 and complex multi-chip programming.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Marked Atari's final standalone home hardware release, highlighting the industrial shift toward unified Japanese and 32-bit CD-ROM architectures.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Controller with directional pad, three fire buttons, and 12-key numeric keypad
